main_text.l: duo millia virorum aut circiter tria
lo fere tria millia virorum, & fugerũt
funt eos à porta vsque ad Sebarim,&
ta liquefactum est cor populi, fuitque
procidítque in faciem suam in terram
coram arca Iehouæ vsque ad vesperā,

page.notes: Catchword "Dixítque" at the foot right; the paragraph beginning with 7 is continued on the next page. Some letters in the scan are faint; readings of "vestimēta", "vesperā" and "posuerūt" are slightly doubtful.
